channel.title: Aviation, shipping & logistics · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Aviation, shipping & logistics in Indian markets. Today: headwind (−2.5).

item.title: [−2] Hormuz traffic down to 4 ships a day versus 85 before the war; Iran halts 'non-compliant' vessels
item.description:
Three tankers were damaged in the Gulf and Türkiye urged Iran's Guard to stop attacks. Iran again offered to reopen the strait if the US lifts its blockade of Iranian ports. Escalating, with a standing offer.

Aviation, shipping & logistics: headwind (−2) — Freight and insurance at records

Why it matters: Near-closure keeps crude near $117 and freight at records, widening India's import bill; any deal on the blockade would be the biggest single relief for Indian markets.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −2, Inflation outlook −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] Fresh Houthi attacks hit Saudi oil facilities and airports; Indian flights to Riyadh and Dammam disrupted
item.description:
Riyadh's airport has been attacked 20 times in October, and Saudi Arabia launched new strikes on the Houthis. The Houthis threatened the US if it joins. Escalating.

Aviation, shipping & logistics: mild headwind (−1) — Gulf flights disrupted

Why it matters: Attacks on India's largest non-Hormuz crude supplier keep oil near six-month highs, while disrupted Gulf flights hit airlines and travel to a region with millions of Indian workers.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] US envoy says strikes on Iran could come 'as soon as this weekend'; Iran bars US warships from the Gulf
item.description:
The US Treasury chief said the US Navy could escort ships through Hormuz with an international coalition. Iran said US warships would never be allowed into the Gulf. Escalating risk.

Aviation, shipping & logistics: mild headwind (−1) — War risk

Why it matters: A renewed US strike would likely push oil sharply higher and hit Indian equities and the rupee; escorts, if they work, could restore some flows.

Market gauges: Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1, Fiscal & trade balance −1

Confidence: low · horizon: days
